story_type: crab boat sinks at night, two men in a life raft, infrared, helicopter hoists
hook: A crab boat going under at night. Two men in a raft.
narration: This forty six foot crab boat was going under, at night, off the Washington coast.
It went down near Willapa Bay, on a February evening.
At about seven thirty, its emergency beacon started transmitting.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Astoria was overhead about forty minutes later.
Its infrared camera sees heat, so people in the cold water glow white against the sea.
Two men had made it into a life raft.
A rescue swimmer rode the cable down and brought them up one at a time.
[short pause] Then he went back down for the second man.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted both men from the raft. A third crewman was never found, and the search was suspended.
title: Crab boat sank at night off Washington
description:
A 46-foot crabbing vessel sank near Willapa Bay, Washington, on Feb. 5, 2023. A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Astoria hoisted two men from a life raft; a third crewman was not found.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Steven Strohmaier, U.S. Coast Guard Northwest, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/872568/coast-guard-rescues-two-men-near-willapa-bay
